# vc.Agentic

This repository is a library of reusable, agent-neutral skills, task templates, and component samples. It is not an application or an agent runtime.

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first. It names the entry point: start with `.agents/skills/skill-discovery-guide/SKILL.md`, then `.agents/skills/skill-selection/SKILL.md`, and read only the skills the task needs.
